{"binding":"have","type":"revAcc (revAcc xs []) [] = xs","term":"by
  have h : ∀ (xs ys : List Nat), revAcc (revAcc xs ys) [] = revAcc ys xs := by
    intro xs
    induction xs with
    | nil =>
        intro ys
        rfl
    | cons a xs ih =>
        intro ys
        simp only [revAcc]
        exact ih (a :: ys)
  simpa [revAcc] using h xs []"}
